about: The slice's acceptance: every scenario whose subject is something the slice builds (the shell, the desk, the pure-data modules, the Pedalboard with its pure-data pedals and side unit, undo and redo, the autosave, the theme, the tiers, adding, removing and moving). Each must pass on every run (tools/behaviour/run.mjs --slice). A work package adds a file of its own beside this one (acceptance/<package>.json); none edits another's. `excluded` lists scenarios that look like the slice's but are left out, each with the reason, so that a reader can check the choice. tools/behaviour/switches.mjs proves the list has teeth: each slice feature switched off makes at least one of these fail.

scenarios.why: The engine button and its panel's five cards: arrows, Enter, Escape, a click outside.
Adding from the Modules panel with the keyboard.
The side panels collapse to their rails and expand, and the choice is kept over a reload.
Below 1400px the Modules panel opens over the desk and closes on a press outside or Escape; Lab below 1600px puts the Workflows panel on its rail.
Below 1180px the panels are drawers: focus goes in, the scrim and Escape close them, adding from one closes it (SL-07).
The toast: holds while hovered, its action, its dismiss button, a replaced message.
The board's cables: one per link, on the jacks, redrawn as pedals come and go.
The desk lays out the same without the web fonts.
Taking a pedal off moves focus to the next pedal; Undo brings it back with focus on it (SL-05).
Undo with nothing to undo says so; a run of moves on one grip is one step; undo puts back a move and an add.
A tile's grip: an arrow moves it one visible step, a refused move is said and changes nothing.
The same tiles in the same order give the same desk.
The tier switch does not move under the pointer as the tier changes.
Pedals line up across tiers and keep their state.
A pedal switched off stays drawn bypassed, with focus inside; the board's count.
StableStep's knobs keep their cells when Source blend changes; the fixed seed takes only a seed.
Every step is named in the page's words.
Avoid's note: the text fills the sheet.
Whisper's LCD stays inside its unit.
The note above the desk names the Lab modules a tier hides.
Five tier changes in a row raise no error.
Lab pedals snap to their controls' height.
A value set keeps every tile's width (Q-29).
Same, another desk.
Same, another desk.
Same, another desk.
Same, another desk.
Same, another desk.
Pending (F-20) in the concept, right here: rapid tier and theme switching leaves no error.
Pending (F-25) in the concept, right here: adding from the Modules panel keeps focus on the card; a parked module's toast carries Undo.
The engine switch's toast: a few sentences, naming what is new on the engine and nothing already on the desk (E-11, E-19).
A number control's keys: arrows, Shift, Page, Home and End, each a named step; past an end it stays and says nothing.
Undo and redo by Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z, Ctrl+Y, the buttons and the toast, each said in the toast and the live region.
The autosave and its restore: tier, modules, pedals and values after a reload.
The theme switch: Light, Dark, kept over a reload, the arrows go round to System.
An engine switch from its panel: the toast with Undo, said, a module the engine does not use parked.
Alt+1, 2, 3, the switch's arrows and clicks; a tier is not an undo step.
Adding from a starter and a card, adding what is there rings it, removing with Undo, focus, the Pedalboard coming and going with its pedals.

excluded.why: Vacuous here: it presses F9 and checks the picker fits; the rebuild has no picker yet, and nothing to fit passes. The picker's package (8) adds it.
Vacuous here: it checks the prompt card has no From chip; the rebuild has no prompt card. The prompt's package (4).

Its second check (a click on a Modules card moves focus to the new tile) is what F-25 found wrong and the slice puts right (21-chrome-round5/adding-from-the-panel-answers-one-way); its first (a starter) is in 30-slice/add-and-remove-with-undo.
The same conflict with F-25: Enter on a card keeps focus on the card here.

Mostly the slice's, but it also opens Song info and Cover art (the generation package's). Its slice checks (a pedal knob turns, adding a pedal already there rings it, x with Undo) are in 30-slice/add-and-remove-with-undo and 30-slice/knob-keys-keep-the-value-contract.
It reads the concept's storage key (hs3-theme; deviation 8) and the other pages (navigation stubs here). Its theme checks are in 30-slice/theme-is-chosen-kept-and-keyed.
